$description: Reco's theme, in the Design Tokens format (W3C DTCG, as Refero exports it). `color` is the source palette; `role` is what the app uses, each role's `$value` its dark colour (an alias like {color.void} or a hex) and `$extensions.com.reco.theme` its light and Increase Contrast colours. To change themes: replace `color` with the new palette, point the roles at it (and set their light and high-contrast values), then run `scripts/apply-theme.py`, which writes Reco/Assets.xcassets. ThemeContrastTests fails if a role misses WCAG AA contrast or the asset catalog no longer matches this file. `font` and `radius` are read by Typeface.swift and EditorTheme.swift; the tests check they match.

void.$description: Void — Page canvas, full-bleed backgrounds — the default everything sits on

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card surfaces, nav bars — one step above canvas for contained content

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Elevated surfaces, deeper card panels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subtle borders, dividers, ghost button outlines — low-contrast structural edges

smoke.$description: Smoke — Hairline borders at higher contrast than graphite — section separators

ash.$description: Ash — Muted body text, inactive icons, secondary metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, placeholder copy, icon fills

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary headings, button text on dark surfaces

bone.$description: Bone — Near-white surface fills, high-contrast button text

paper.$description: Paper — Primary headings, hero type, max-contrast emphasis text

acid-lime.$description: Acid Lime — Primary action buttons, active nav indicators — electric accent that breaks the monochrome system

pulse-green.$description: Pulse Green — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

coral-red.$description: Coral Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

signal-teal.$description: Signal Teal — Decorative accent, informational icon fills

iris-violet.$description: Iris Violet — Tag/badge fills — soft chromatic punctuation on tags and labels

lavender.$description: Lavender — Secondary tag fills, category indicators

stage.$description: EditorTheme.stage — window grounds: the editor's preview, the Library's grid, Settings

surface.$description: EditorTheme.surface — cards and floating panels: the capture toolbar, the Quick Access card, the popover

raised.$description: EditorTheme.raised — what floats over a surface: tooltips, the source picker, chosen tabs

control.$description: EditorTheme.control — controls' own fill: secondary buttons, tracks, chips, chosen tiles

hairline.$description: EditorTheme.hairline — lines between areas and around surfaces

ink.$description: EditorTheme.ink — text; at least 7:1 on every surface

dim.$description: EditorTheme.dim — values, notes and other secondary text; at least 4.5:1

faint.$description: EditorTheme.faint — structure marks only (ruler ticks, chevrons), never text; at least 3:1. Ash a step lighter: ash itself is 2.66:1 on control

accent.$description: EditorTheme.accent (the AccentColor asset, Color.accentColor) — lines, text and marks in the accent: playhead, selection, chosen tab, native controls' tint; at least 3:1. Olive in light, where lime on white is 1.2:1

accentFill.$description: EditorTheme.accentFill — the accent as a fill (primary buttons, what is on), always with onAccent on it

onAccent.$description: EditorTheme.onAccent — text and icons on accentFill; at least 7:1 on it

sans.$description: Typeface.sans — every label, title and control. Reco/Fonts/InterVariable.ttf (SIL OFL 1.1); a new family needs its font file there

mono.$description: Typeface.mono — shortcuts, file names, code. Reco/Fonts/JetBrainsMono.ttf (SIL OFL 1.1), in place of the paid Berkeley Mono
